description: This Java class implements a generic, non-thread-safe evicting queue with a fixed capacity. It provides methods to add, remove, and peek elements, automatically evicting oldest elements when capacity is exceeded.

classes.name: DefaultEvictingQueue
classes.description: A non-thread-safe fixed-capacity queue that evicts oldest elements when capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: withCapacity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new evicting queue with specified capacity.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in the queue.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Attempts to add an element to the queue, evicting the oldest if full.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on capacity and elements.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on capacity and elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the queue.
